primitive: An extensible typed facet payload on the canonical jet-receipt-v2 receipt with shared query and diff access.
evidence: Source/ReceiptStore.rs:47-54 fixes Receipt to claim/status/stdout/stderr/digest, and :301-328 write accepts only those fields; `jet status src/evidence.jet --json` emits only action/claim/reason/receipt/state, while `jet perf compare .jet/replays/evidence.jetproof-replay .jet/replays/evidence-shifted.jetproof-replay` returns Error [E2102]: Base trace: trace path must end with .jettrace.
workaround: Keep a domain record in program memory or stdout and compare it outside Jet; it cannot become a shared receipt field or typed receipt query.

primitive: A replay adapter that executes a successfully captured ambient Time read in the source debugger.
evidence: `jet run src/replay.jet --record=clock2 -- foo` prints captured:1788388744998 and `capture: finalized outcome=exit status=0` with artifact `.jet/replays/clock2.jetproof-replay`; `jet debug src/replay.jet --replay=clock2` opens `Time; dev-tir-v1`, stops at `time.now()`, then returns [E0956] `static `time.now`` isn't supported by the current evaluator yet`.
workaround: Route time through an injected deterministic Clock and query pure recorded acts; captured ambient Time remains un-replayable.

primitive: Replay queries that render user-defined evidence with its Jet source type name rather than an internal generated name.
evidence: `printf 'when evidence\ncontinue\n' | jet debug src/evidence.jet --replay=evidence` returns `(jet) evidence = __jet_RegressionEvidence { __jet_slope: 1.9, ... }`; crates/jet-debug/src/lib.rs:3-6 promises values are in Jet terms and never generated Rust.
workaround: Query scalar fields individually or inspect the program's printed JSON instead of the replay object rendering.
